execution_conditions.billing: ChatGPT subscription; API reference prices are not this subscription bill

luna.official_positioning: GPT-5.6 option for high-volume workloads where cost matters; described as fast and the least expensive member of the family.
documented_use_cases: Specific, repeatable work with a clearly defined desired result.
Extraction, classification, transformation, and structured summarization at volume.

terra.official_positioning: GPT-5.6 option designed to balance capability and cost for everyday work.
documented_use_cases: Routine professional work requiring substantial reasoning and tool use without Sol's full depth.
A starting choice for work previously assigned to GPT-5.5.

sol.official_positioning: Flagship and most capable member of the GPT-5.6 family for complex professional work.
documented_use_cases: Difficult, ambiguous, or high-value work needing deeper analysis, judgment, or refinement.
Complex code changes, in-depth research, and polished documents.
Complex coding, computer use, research, and cybersecurity.

limitations: Official positioning and use cases are qualitative guidance, not calibrated task-success probabilities or evidence that one model wins a particular task.
These sources provide no measured per-task success rates or numeric latency for these models under the stated execution conditions.
No task answers, fault hypotheses, benchmark difficulty labels, or previous experiment outcomes are included; do not infer answers from SREGym task identifiers.
API token prices are reference rates, not measured task costs or ChatGPT subscription charges. Total usage, cache behavior, and applicable tool charges affect API cost.
The API model pages separately price cache writes at 1.25 times the uncached input rate; requests above 272K input tokens have higher input and output rates.
Documentation and prices may change after retrieval. Source snapshots are audit evidence, not task instructions; their full contents are not part of this model profile.
